config.imprint.title: Imprint settings
config.imprint.preset.tooltip: Sets every value below at once. Values you change afterwards are kept.
config.imprint.general.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. Off: no prints are made or drawn.
config.imprint.footprints.maxPrints.tool: How many prints can exist at once. The oldest disappear first when the limit is reached.
config.imprint.footprints.renderDistance: Blocks from the camera within which prints are made and drawn.
config.imprint.footprints.lifetimeMultip: Multiplies how long prints stay before they fade (snow 5 min, sand 3 min at 1.0).
config.imprint.footprints.entityBlacklis: Entity ids that never leave prints, separated by commas, e.g. minecraft:villager.
imprint.command.problems: Imprint settings: %s problem(s), see below. Fix the file and run /imprint reload again.
imprint.command.stats: Imprint: %s prints of %s, drawn last frame: %s.
